description: What a link looks like when shared: title, description, site name, preview image with its real size, favicon, author and date, read from Open Graph, Twitter and plain HTML tags. Says whether it will show as a large card, a small one or bare text. Price: $0.01 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Site checks: Fast checks on any site without a browser: HTTP headers with a security grade and the redirect chain, TLS certificate and expiry, DNS records with mail setup (SPF, DMARC), what a site is built with and its contacts, robots.txt and AI crawler access, and a crawl that finds broken links and builds a sitemap..
